segments.text: Queſt. 108th. What doth the ſeventh Command teach us?
Anſ. That all Uncleanneſs is accurſed of God, and that therefore we muſt with all our Hearts deteſt the ſame, and live chaſtely and temperately, whether in holy Wedlock, or in a ſingle Life.
Queſt. 109th. Doth God forbid in this Command, only Adultery, and ſuch like groſs Sins?

Anſ. Since both our Body and Soul are Temples of the Holy Ghoſt, He commands us to preſerve them pure and holy; therefore he forbids all unchaſte Actions, Geſtures, Words, Thoughts, Deſires, and whatever can entice Men thereto.
